subject: Post-call: Procurement & Billing Info (PO vs Card, Invoice Requirements)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sven Larson <sven.larson@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Procurement & Billing Info (PO vs Card, Invoice Requirements)

Hi Sven —

Thanks again for taking the call today — great conversation and appreciate the clear signals that Acme is interested in piloting Redwood for your customer service summarization use case. Quick recap from our discovery + a few ask items so we can move the commercial path forward: 

Recap:
- Pilot scope: 3 dedicated inference endpoints, ~5M tokens/month, 90% internal traffic, expected pilot start mid-Oct
- Success criteria: <200ms p95 latency, < $0.005/token operational target, integration with your internal key management

Outstanding procurement/billing questions:
1) Purchase method: Do you intend to purchase via PO (vendor setup) or corporate card?
2) Marketplace: Would you prefer procurement through AWS Marketplace (if yes we can surface pricing there) or direct invoice?
3) Net terms: Any preferred net terms (Net30/Net45/Net60)?
4) Invoice format / delivery: PDF invoice attached is our standard sample — do you need EDI/Coupa/e-invoicing?
5) Billing details: Exact legal entity name, billing address, and VAT/GST or tax ID to include on the invoice.
6) PO process: Any vendor setup or tax forms we should complete before issuing an invoice (W-9, vendor questionnaire)?

I attached our Redwood_Standard_Invoice_Sample.pdf to show the line-item layout we typically provide. 

If you can reply with the items above (or loop in your billing contact), Rishi and I will prepare a formal quote + SOW and a draft invoice aligned to your requirements. Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call with finance if that helps move the PO along.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: Redwood_Standard_Invoice_Sample.pdf]

From: Sven Larson <sven.larson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@acme.com
Date: 2026-09-11T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Billing Info (PO vs Card, Invoice Requirements)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement side:

1) Purchase method: We will need to go through our PO process (vendor setup) — corporate card is not the primary path for this engagement.
2) Marketplace: We prefer direct invoicing for procurement of vendor services for pilots; we may request marketplace for scaled production later.
3) Net terms: Standard is Net30 for pilots.
4) Invoice format: PDF invoice emailed to billing@acme.com is fine. We also accept invoices via Coupa if you have that integration (please indicate if you can e-invoice).
5) Billing details (legal entity):
   - Legal name: Acme Corporation
   - Billing address: 100 Innovation Way, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105
   - VAT / Tax ID: US EIN 12-3456789
6) Vendor setup: Please complete the attached procurement requirements document (includes vendor questionnaire and tax forms). We will need a W-9 on file for Redwood.

I've attached ACME_procurement_requirements.pdf and copied billing@acme.com for the finance-specific items. Our procurement team typically requires a quote that shows line-item SKUs, unit pricing, and a total. Also include a place for the PO number to be referenced on the invoice.

Happy to set a short call between your finance lead and ours next week if helpful.

Best,

Sven Larson
Director, Strategic Procurement
Acme Corporation
sven.larson@acme.com
[Attachment: ACME_procurement_requirements.pdf]

From: Billing Ops <billing@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sven Larson <sven.larson@acme.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Billing Info (PO vs Card, Invoice Requirements)

Hi Marissa —

Quick note from billing ops with the specifics we need to process payment without delays: 

- Invoice must include: our PO number (when provided), vendor legal name, vendor remit-to address, and vendor tax ID.
- Line-item breakdown by SKU (description, qty, unit price, extended price) and subtotal + tax + total.
- We prefer PDF invoices sent to billing@acme.com and an electronic copy uploaded to Coupa (our portal ID: ACME-Coupa-12345) if available.
- Please include your ACH details (bank name, account number, routing) or remit-to mailing address for check payments.
- Required docs: W-9 (US vendors) or W-8/W-9 equivalents for international vendors.

If you plan to route via AWS Marketplace later, confirm timelines — that often requires separate vendor enrollment and can add ~2-3 weeks.

Thanks,
Acme Billing Ops
billing@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sven Larson <sven.larson@acme.com>, billing@acme.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Billing Info (PO vs Card, Invoice Requirements)

Thanks Sven / Billing team — this is super helpful and exactly what we needed. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) I'll send over a formal quote + draft SOW today that includes the SKU-level breakdown and a sample invoice that matches your format.
2) We'll attach our W-9 and vendor paperwork; Rishi will own the vendor setup forms and can complete anything in your procurement packet.
3) We can accept Coupa e-invoicing — Rishi will confirm the integration path and provide our Coupa vendor ID (if required).
4) We'll keep this as PO-based for the pilot with Net30 terms unless you confirm otherwise.

Can you let us know the expected PO issuance timeline? If it helps, we can schedule a 20-min call between Rishi + me and your procurement/billing contacts on Tuesday morning (we're flexible).

DocuSign link for the standard Redwood SaaS Order Form (will attach in the quote): https://docusign.com/REPLACE_WITH_ACTUAL_LINK

Appreciate the quick turnaround here — aiming to have paperwork in place so the pilot can start by mid-October.

Best,\nMarissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
